sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to finish the line 'judgment begins with the ___ of God.' Card 10 only says judgment begins, so the baker has no context to reason out 'family' over 'enemies' or 'prophets.' The pick comes down to luck or to remembering the wording.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

sonnet.problem: Story card 13 quotes all of 4:18 right before this card, including 'If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?' That quote already tells the baker the ungodly do not have an easier road. The true/false card just re-asks what card 13 told, and card 12 already covered the same rhetorical question from 4:17.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
